description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_Strategy which serves as a supertype for classes implementing different strategies to modify or purify tokens in the HTMLPurifier library. It provides a common interface for executing strategies on token arrays, enabling customization of HTML purification processes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy
classes.description: An abstract class that defines the interface for strategy classes that modify or purify tokens within the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method that executes the specific strategy on the provided tokens, using the given configuration and context, and returns the processed tokens.
